reports.excerpt: An initial bulletin from the town response office said 18 homes were evacuated after a retaining wall shifted beside Lark Street at about 6:40 a.m. A nearby resident told the Record that overnight rain may have weakened the slope. The bulletin said no injuries had been reported.

A retaining wall shifted beside Lark Street at about 6:40 a.m., and residents in nearby buildings were moved as a precaution. No injuries had been reported. The cause of the movement was under investigation.

Correction: The phrase '18 homes were evacuated' in our earlier update was inaccurate. Eighteen residents from seven apartments were temporarily relocated; 11 had returned by 10:15 a.m. The town said inspection had not established why the wall shifted. No injuries had been reported.
